card.name: See cross-references after a sentence
card.fires_on: The word "see" opening a bracketed cross-reference at the end of a sentence in drug-label highlights. It is followed by a section name and number, such as Adverse Reactions (6.1).

modes.label: See before Adverse Reactions
modes.description: A bracketed "see" points to the Adverse Reactions section after a finding is stated.
modes.example: ITUXAN HYCELA. Symptoms included pain, swelling, induration, hemorrhage, erythema, pruritus, and rash [<<see>> Adverse Reactions (6.1

modes.label: See before other sections
modes.description: A bracketed "see" points to Warnings, Drug Interactions, Dosage or Contraindications.
modes.example: several possible causes, including a drug-drug interaction between JUXTAPID and the strong CYP3A4 inhibitor clarithromycin [<<see>> Drug Interactions (7.1)

card.writes: It pushes toward words that point elsewhere in the text, such as "below", "detail" and "later".
card.plain: It marks the word "see" that sends the reader to another label section for more detail.
